# KaTeX

Version: 0.19.0. Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz

The release archive has SHA-1 `b69c8cbcfc8c331be3f4f6e606b02b7146501ec7`.
The renderer and WOFF2 fonts are distributed under the included MIT license.
The stylesheet includes WOFF2 sources; WOFF and TTF fallbacks are omitted.
`scripts/render_math.cjs` uses the bundled renderer during the site build.
Published pages load the local stylesheet and fonts without a runtime renderer.
